[IDAT.3.3.3] **Builders own.** Each `ds_json_new_*` yields a
freshly owned node in its out-param. The caller must dispose of it
exactly once, one of three ways: `ds_json_free` it; transfer it
into a parent via `ds_json_array_append` / `ds_json_object_set`;
or hand it to the engine as a `DS_SLOT_JSON` slot value — the
engine deep-clones it on assert ([NFCT.2.4]), so the caller still
owns and must free its built tree afterward.
